mission_06: Well done! You have successfully applied ADASYN and compared it with SMOTE. You learned how ADASYN adaptively generates more synthetic samples for minority class instances that are harder to learn, while SMOTE generates a uniform number of samples. Notice that ADASYN may generate a different total number of samples compared to SMOTE because its adaptive nature means it focuses computational effort where it is most needed. Use ADASYN when your minority class has complex decision boundaries and some samples are significantly harder to classify than others. For simpler imbalanced problems, SMOTE may be sufficient and more predictable.
